Industry SME – Mining Industry SME: Candidate Profile

Role overview

Item

Detail

Position

Industry Expert – Mining

Department

Industry SME, Enterprise/B2B

Company

PT XLSmart Telecom Sejahtera Tbk

Location

Jakarta, with regular travel to mine sites across Indonesia

Reports to

Head of Industry SME

We are looking for a mining industry insider who can turn connectivity and digital technology into measurable outcomes for mine operators. You will own the Mining vertical end to end: spotting the problems worth solving, customers’ pain points, shaping solutions and business cases, winning executive sponsorship, and seeing projects through from proof of value to delivery.

This is a builder role. You will set up XLSmart's mining playbook, partner ecosystem and first pioneer projects in the sector.

Key responsibilities

You will cover the full solution lifecycle for the Mining vertical, from first idea to delivered project.

• Ideation and innovation
• Map operational pain points across the mining value chain: exploration, mine planning, production, haulage, processing and port logistics.
• Identify where connectivity, IoT, private networks, cloud and AI can improve safety, productivity and cost.
• Track industry trends, regulation and downstreaming (smelter) programs to build a pipeline of use cases.
• Solution and business case development
• Design end-to-end solutions with product, network and pre-sales teams.
• Build business cases and ROI models that translate technology into operational and financial outcomes.
• Package repeatable offerings and reference architectures for the vertical.
• Customer engagement up to C-level
• Act as the trusted industry advisor to mine owners, contractors and processing companies.
• Engage site managers, technical heads, directors and C-level executives.
• Support account teams on strategy, proposals, tenders and negotiations.
• Partner ecosystem
• Build alliances with mining technology vendors, OEMs, system integrators and software providers.
• Structure joint go-to-market offers and consortia for large opportunities.
• Proof of value and proof of concept
• Define POV/POC scope, success criteria and commercial path to scale.
• Lead execution on site with internal teams and partners.
• Project delivery
• Oversee delivery of won projects with delivery and operations teams.
• Ensure outcomes are measured and turned into lighthouse references.

Ideal candidate: experience

The ideal candidate has worked inside mine operations and then moved into selling and growing technology or engineering business for the sector.

Must have

• 7+ years of total experience in the mining industry.
• 3+ years of hands-on mining operations or engineering: mine planning, geotechnical, dewatering, haulage or production support, ideally with a major mining contractor or operator.
• 3+ years in technical sales, pre-sales or business development for mining software, technology, equipment or EPC services.
• A proven record of winning deals or contracts, from opportunity shaping through tender and negotiation.
• An active network across Indonesian coal, nickel and mineral operators, contractors and state-owned mining groups.
• Experience presenting to and negotiating with directors and C-level executives.

Nice to have

• Experience with mining digital solutions such as mine planning, fleet management, asset management or slope monitoring systems.
• Exposure to smelter and mineral processing projects.
• Experience building consortia or partnerships with technology vendors and sub-contractors.
• Software implementation, customer training or international project experience.
• Thought leadership: published papers, conference talks or guest lecturing.
• Familiarity with connectivity, IoT or private network solutions.

Qualifications and competencies

Education and certification

• Bachelor's degree in Mining, Geological, or a related engineering discipline.
• Professional engineer title (IPP or higher) is preferred.
• Mining competency certifications are an advantage, for example Pengawas Operasional (POP/POM) or Competent Person in mine planning.

Core competencies

Competency

What it looks like in this role

Industry depth

Speaks the language of mine sites and boardrooms; understands how operations make money

Consultative selling

Uncovers business problems before proposing technology

Business acumen

Builds credible business cases, pricing and ROI models

Ecosystem building

Brings vendors, integrators and customers together into winning offers

Execution

Drives POCs and projects to agreed outcomes and timelines with sound commercial

Communication

Clear, confident presentations and proposals in English and Bahasa Indonesia

Ownership

Works autonomously and builds a new vertical from the ground up

Employment Status:

Contract (C)

* Coordinate with the technical support and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery and excellent customer service.
* Prepare and submit regular sales reports, forecasts, and market analysis to the Sales Manager.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Medicine, Agribusiness, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2–3 years of proven experience as a Sales Executive, preferably within the livestock, animal feed, or poultry industry.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Result-driven mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Willingness to travel frequently to various regions to meet clients and explore market opportunities.
* Possession of a valid driver’s license (SIM A and/or SIM C).
* Fluency in Indonesian; basic proficiency in English is an advantage.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
